midi.extra_or_reordered_events_policy: Reject in this fixed preparation domain.

dev_render.wav_origin: MIDI tick0 at WAV sample0; preserve pre-NoteOn silence and full EOT duration.
dev_render.parameters: Use unchanged former static render controls and record all applied values.
dev_render.existing_output: Reject without overwriting any previous files.
dev_render.observation: Record actual first/last nonzero output and NoteOff/key/voice observations; first sound is not assumed to equal the input event sample.

analysis_windows.coordinate: Seconds after MIDI NoteOn; half-open sample ranges.
analysis_windows.note_off_boundary: W2 ends at NoteOff; do not silently include release samples.
analysis_windows.sample_mapping: note_on_sample + llround(relative_seconds*rate); note_on_sample is independently bound to this WAV before resolving a window
analysis_windows.old_PPA_behavior: Current consumed-data diagnosis explicitly selects file_absolute with its original absolute-window truncation; it is not v3 evidence or a fallback for a missing NoteOn.
analysis_windows.reference_evidence_policy: Reference authentication is not implemented by a flag or this contract; an A4 dev report must never authorize a reference input.
analysis_windows.reported_bounds: Each window retains relative seconds, actual start_sample/stop_sample, coordinate and timing evidence role. Reject a release-crossing or unavailable window without clipping or promoting another window.

reference_origin.requirement: Bind MIDI timing to actual reference export origin using independent recorded evidence.
reference_origin.existing_consumed_wav_role: Read-only content/timing diagnosis, not fresh holdout or origin certification.
reference_origin.note: Bounded diagnostic capture completed 2026-10-18 with four cold sessions / twelve WAVs; see the certificate.

preparation_domain.role: Already-consumed authenticated diagnostic control, not new reference validation.
